AdGuard Home applies whitelist filters *over* blocklists, so while that filter is enabled
these hostnames resolve normally instead of being blocked. The filter is off by default in
this deployment; the list below is what you give up by turning it off, and what comes back
if you turn it on.

## The trade-off / 取舍

- **Leave it off** (current): all of these stay blocked. Referral and affiliate links that
  funnel through these trackers may fail to redirect.
- **Leave it on**: referral links work, but mobile attribution SDKs such as `adjust.com` and
  `appsflyer.com`, plus `a9.com`, `ad.doubleclick.net` and `amazon-adsystem.com`, resolve again.
- **Middle path** (recommended): keep it off and add only the referral hosts you actually use
  to `user_rules` in `C:\AdGuardHome\AdGuardHome.yaml`, as `@@||host^` lines.

## How to keep a referral host working / 如何保留某个返利域名

Add the exact hostname to `user_rules` in `C:\AdGuardHome\AdGuardHome.yaml`, then restart
the service. User rules are applied last and win over the blocklist:

```yaml
user_rules:
  - '@@||adjust.com^'   # only if you really need the Adjust SDK to resolve
```
